notes: Native WebGPU/TSL-only validation sample; no WebGL fallback.
Exercises native DLSS Super Resolution evaluation with real HDR color, depth and TSL motion-vector resources, plus Reflex.
When supported, Frame Generation consumes a real post-tonemapped RGBA8 HUD-less target, native depth and dense TSL motion vectors; native post-Present state remains authoritative.
Ray Reconstruction is deliberately not requested because the sample has no noisy ray-traced lighting inputs.
Registers static terrain, rocks and debris through navigator.gpu.threeBrowserRTX, then evaluates native Vulkan ray-query sun visibility, RTAO and refracted-water caustics in the HDR frame path.
Keeps a full-resolution analytic caustic fallback when native ray query is unavailable or the BLAS/TLAS does not become ready.
